keyVerseDR: "I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil." (Mt 5:17)

level1.title: Love From the Heart
level1.story: Jesus said, "Do not stay angry. Make peace with your brother first." Then bring your gift to God.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What should we do if we are angry?
level1.prayer: Jesus, give me a good and loving heart. Amen.

activity.title: Sign of peace card
activity.intro: Make peace first! Make a card for someone.
activity.to: Someone I want to make peace with

level2.title: Fulfilling the Law
level2.story: Jesus said He came not to abolish the law but to fulfill it. He taught that it is not enough to avoid killing; we must not stay angry with others. "If your brother has something against you, leave your gift at the altar," He said. "First go and make peace, then come and offer your gift." Jesus also said, "Let your 'Yes' mean yes and your 'No' mean no."
level2.keyLine: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why does Jesus care about our thoughts and words?
Who do you need to make peace with?
level2.prayer: Jesus, make my heart match Your law of love. Amen.

activity.title: What would Jesus say?
activity.intro: Match each situation to Jesus' teaching.
pairs: I'm still angry at my brother
I want to break my promise
I want to call a friend a mean name
I'm about to go to Mass
Be reconciled, then bring your gift

art.mainBrief: Jesus gently teaching; two children making up after a fight
